theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  have h_inj : Set.InjOn f s := by intro x y; cases hx with x hx; cases hy with y hy; rw [hf at hx]; rw [hf at hy]; eq_iff_true.1 (eq_of_fst_eq_snd hx hy)
  have h_maps_to : Set.MapsTo f s s := by intro x hx; exact ⟨f x, by simp [hf]⟩
  have h_bij : Set.BijectiveOn f s := by refine ⟨h_inj, h_maps_to⟩
  have h_image_image : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    apply congr
    apply funext
    intro x
    cases x with x hx
    rw [Set.image_eq]
    apply iff.intro
    · intro h
      rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact hz
    · intro h
      rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h_image_image
